note: Diagnostic builds and isolated, temporary ablations. Product checkout implementations were not modified. Background tasks retained at user request.
measurement_notes: ui_draw measures whole-window wall time, including tree building, prepaint, paint, and frame finishing; not pure GPU or input-to-photon latency.
Physics uses 40 formal + 5 warmup text commits at 120 Hz; playback phase 900/120=7.5 seconds. Native scripted input includes synchronous dispatch draws.

Layout counters are collected via existing Window layout_stats/reset_layout_stats APIs at display callbacks. Synchronous input can execute 405/450 draws between callbacks, so Physics layout work averages include the 5 warmup commits. Formal ui_draw quantiles, render counters, form-reset counters, and Select-setter counters exclude warmup.
Do not interpret layout block averages as per-frame quantiles. compute_layout is nested in prepaint and shape/measure times overlap their callers.
Compiler presence is monitored each second and conservatively flagged, even for an idle Cargo process. A flag does not itself prove CPU contention. No background jobs were paused or killed.
Bounds-only guard did not reduce playback Properties renders; retained as a negative result. Searchable no-op guard preserved content and eliminated repeated setter notifications.
CPU samples use a sampler and stretched 5 Hz Physics input; they are for stack attribution only, not performance comparison. Physics samples also observed compilers.
